---
title: Update Blockhash
description: Update the blockhash of a Solana Transaction
---

`decompileTransactionMessage` returns addresses, not signers. Call `setTransactionMessageFeePayerSigner` with the original fee payer before signing, or `signTransactionMessageWithSigners` reports the fee payer signature as missing. `wallet.json` has to be that signer.

```tsx
import {
    assertIsTransactionWithBlockhashLifetime,
    createKeyPairSignerFromBytes,
    createSolanaRpc,
    decompileTransactionMessage,
    getBase64EncodedWireTransaction,
    getBase64Encoder,
    getCompiledTransactionMessageDecoder,
    getTransactionDecoder,
    mainnet,
    pipe,
    setTransactionMessageFeePayerSigner,
    setTransactionMessageLifetimeUsingBlockhash,
    signTransactionMessageWithSigners,
} from "@solana/kit";
import walletSecret from "./wallet.json";

const base64Tx = "";

const rpc = createSolanaRpc(mainnet("https://api.mainnet-beta.solana.com"));
const payer = await createKeyPairSignerFromBytes(new Uint8Array(walletSecret));

const wireTransaction = getTransactionDecoder().decode(getBase64Encoder().encode(base64Tx));
const compiled = getCompiledTransactionMessageDecoder().decode(wireTransaction.messageBytes);
const message = decompileTransactionMessage(compiled);

const { value: latestBlockhash } = await rpc.getLatestBlockhash().send();
console.log("New Blockhash:", latestBlockhash.blockhash);

const updated = pipe(
    message,
    (tx) => setTransactionMessageFeePayerSigner(payer, tx),
    (tx) => setTransactionMessageLifetimeUsingBlockhash(latestBlockhash, tx),
);

const signedTransaction = await signTransactionMessageWithSigners(updated);
assertIsTransactionWithBlockhashLifetime(signedTransaction);

const updatedBase64Tx = getBase64EncodedWireTransaction(signedTransaction);
console.log(updatedBase64Tx);

const simulation = await rpc.simulateTransaction(updatedBase64Tx, {
    encoding: "base64",
    commitment: "confirmed",
    sigVerify: false,
    replaceRecentBlockhash: true,
}).send();
console.log(simulation);
```
